definitions: The act of rendering someone unconscious, typically with a blow.
The act of eliminating a competitor from a contest or competition.
The act of producing or creating something quickly and efficiently.
The act of making something inoperable or destroying it.
examples: He was knocking out the opponent with a single punch.
The team was knocking out their rivals in every round.
She was knocking out new designs every week.
The virus was knocking out systems across the network.
